comment: Model tier facts (MODEL_PRICE_BANDS / MODEL_BAND_PURPOSE / BAND_BENCHMARK / BAND_QUALITY_FLOOR_GAP / TIER_GATE_CRITERIA). Operator-edited: prices and benchmark names drift, so re-tune here instead of editing serve.py. Price bands are USD per million blended tokens; benchmark entries are ordered fallback chains.

band_purpose.low: Routine, high-volume work: short in-character replies, simple task narration. Needs to be cheap above all else, but still coherent -- not a model too weak to follow basic instructions.
band_purpose.sublow: Short, bounded test scenarios run at scale (hundreds of reenactment/testing agents): brief in-character replies, throwaway probes, simple narration. The cheapest model that is still coherent -- hard per-model price ceiling, coherence is the bar, not depth. Never for real deliverables or long-running narrative work, where the coherence loss shows.
band_purpose.mid: Judgment calls: classifying report severity, generating a new hire's onboarding file, deciding what belongs in an agent's own notes. Needs real reasoning, moderate cost is fine.
band_purpose.coding: Writing and reviewing real code (Code Reviewer, and any role that writes code). Correctness of generated code is the whole job here.
band_purpose.high: Breaking a large, vague request into as many concrete, well-scoped subtasks as the work actually requires (never a fixed count -- a small ask may be one card, a sprawling one many) and deciding how work is distributed (assignBigTask). Runs once per real request, and every downstream call depends on this one being right -- a bad decomposition wastes everything after it, so this is the band to spend on.
band_purpose.3d: 3D modeling work: building, editing, and reviewing three-dimensional scenes or assets. Until a dedicated 3D model is configured, this band routes to coding so the tank can produce the code that builds the scene.

tier_gate_criteria.high: High-stakes, one-shot planning or decomposition where getting it wrong wastes every downstream step (e.g. breaking one large vague request into the subtasks everything else depends on).
tier_gate_criteria.mid: Needs real multi-step reasoning or judgment: synthesis, classification, summarization of gathered material, a considered in-character reply. Routine but non-trivial thinking.
tier_gate_criteria.low: Routine, cheap work: a short reply, simple extraction, or a one-line note where the cheap tier is plenty.
